sources.label: Sheridan County official 2024 general results
sources.url: https://www.sheridancountywy.gov/Document Center/Departments/Elected Office/Election Results/2024 General_election/Summary of Elections Report.pdf

holders.notes: Official 2024 general, 10,572. Western also won the official 2026 at-large contest and is listed on the official June 2026 roster as expiring 2026; both official results are recorded.

groups.note: Municipal, school, and special-district names before the official 2020 general are not all keyed in this preview; those earlier January seats are marked Not yet collected rather than invented. The Town of Clearmont does not appear on the official county November generals reviewed or on the official June 2026 roster. The official 2020 Ranchester council and School District 3 trustee contests listed fewer named candidates than the vote-for number; extra seats are not invented. The official 2024 and 2026 Conservation District at-large results both name Jessica M. Western; both are recorded. Senior Citizens Service District trustees were elected on the official 2026 general and take office in January 2027.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 4th Judicial District judges who appeared by name on a Sheridan County official retention ballot in an adjoining cycle. The official 2018 general lists a 4th Judicial Circuit Court judge retention with no judge’s name; that retention is not attached to a person. Sheryl Smith Bunting is named as Circuit Judge on the official June 12, 2026 clerk roster but did not appear on the official 2026 general summary.
